videos.title: The end of photography as we know it
videos.description:
Is this the end of photography as we know it?
AI can now create, fake, and fabricate almost anything—in seconds. So… where does that leave us as photographers? Does digital photography still stand a chance? Is there a place for film photography in a world run by algorithms? In this video, I dive into the rise of AI-generated images, what it means for the craft we love, and whether photography’s future is something we should fear—or fight for.
